# Marzanna
A frozen moon revolving around Asclepiu. The rivers of Plasma make it energy-rich for any faction willing to control it.
The crust of the moon is entirely made of solid Frezon, which experts dispute the origin of; the only major source (Thrascias) is too deep to justify bringing so much over for an unknown reason.
[color=yellow]This moon was last known to be under the control of the faction known as MAWC.[/color]
